model.calibration: Original 17-feature random forest recipe, refitted from published training data; seed 2026, sklearn 1.8.0. Uncalibrated P(lipid), not lipid identity.

provenance: Bundled BstB reference. Zhai et al., Novel sterol binding domains in bacteria, https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.90696. Prepared copy SHA256 2d7f17dec764dcadcc2d68e578647965cd3a24d5010354c8e40fbb1a73201444. Nine selenomethionines converted to methionine (MSE→MET, Se→S, atom SE→SD): ['A:23', 'A:47', 'A:50', 'A:80', 'A:83', 'A:98', 'A:132', 'A:220', 'A:273']. Atom coordinates unchanged; no minimization or missing-loop reconstruction. Waters and chloride retained in the input, excluded from default inference and docking. The paper reports C-4 methylsterol binding, with no detectable BstB binding to cholesterol or lanosterol under its assay conditions. This example is not a held-out validation or a reproduction of the published docking.
